description: This file serves as the server entry point for a Remix application, handling HTTP requests, rendering React components server-side, and managing streaming responses with support for bot detection.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler that determines if the request is from a bot or a browser, and delegates to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot requests with streaming response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser requests with streaming response.
